facts.text: Southwest Greensburg dates back to 1769 when John Peter Miller received provisional land rights, becoming fully owned by 1789.
Historic Hanna's Town, founded in 1773, once housed Westmoreland County's first government seat and now features a reconstructed tavern and Revolutionary War fort.
The Westmoreland Historical Society headquarters sits in Hanna's Town, operating the History Education Center, research library, and museum shop.
The History Education Center opens Thursday through Saturday from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., welcoming visitors to explore local heritage.
Penny River LLC, run by Jessica Young, creates 18th‑century garments for museums, films like Outlander, and offers workshops on period costume.
Southwest Greensburg hosts hands‑on gardening workshops at Historic Hanna's Town, celebrating Westmoreland County's rich agricultural heritage.
